query:
DELETE FROM git_sync_synced_head h
         WHERE h.synced_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $1)
           AND EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM git_sync_synced_head n
               WHERE n.workspace_id = h.workspace_id
                 AND n.repo_resource_path = h.repo_resource_path
                 AND n.branch = h.branch
                 AND n.synced_at > h.synced_at
           )
